decisions.reason: Defines paste_image/paste_file stems with (2), (3) suffixes before the extension, first candidate unused name with in-batch taken-set recomputation, and paste-only scoping via a paste-source flag so drop and picker keep real names.

Identifies composer occurrences from input.state.getSnapshot() as the authoritative taken-set, explains the records subscription deletes entries on a transient empty snapshot while the attachment is live, and recomputes the taken-set per batch item to cover in-batch reservations.

Uses the captured cached response (x-cache HIT, age 178, s-maxage 300, newest tag v0.2.9) and renderCurrentChip(tag) to explain the stale label, and states the semantic rule: remote > local shows the update, remote <= local shows the running PLUGIN_VERSION, never the older fetched tag.

Proposes cross-batch and same-batch paste tests with concrete expected names, a records-retired-but-live test still yielding (2), drop/picker name-preservation, and chip tests for older, equal, and genuinely newer remote tags.

Requires package.json parity with the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION, node --check of the shipped bundle in CI, and explains real delivery: package-manager upgrade, host restart because client bundles are cached at boot, then page refresh — no host-side auto-update.
